newsitem.title: USA: Physician Corp says seeks credit extension.
newsitem.headline: Physician Corp says seeks credit extension.

text.p: Physician Corp said Monday that as a result of the termination of the Sierra merger agreement the company's credit facility is currently due and it has asked its lenders to allow a reasonable period of time to seek alternatives to meet its obligations under this debt.

Physician said management "believes that the credit facility lenders will consent to the additional time necessary to complete these alternatives and is confident the company will be able to successfully complete a refinancing alternative within an acceptable time frame."

The company said alternatives include: (1) completing a merger/sale transaction, (2) raising equity capital from a venture capital firm, (3) obtaining high yield debt through a private placement, or (4) completing the sale of certain of the Company's assets.

It said it has received indications of interest from third parties related to these four prospective alternatives and believes each alternative to be a viable one which could be completed within a reasonable period of time.
